description: This file is a test suite for functions related to sanitizing prompt text and building system prompts in a software project, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: sanitizeForPromptLiteral
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by removing control characters, Unicode separators, and format characters, preserving regular Unicode characters and spaces.

methods.name: buildAgentSystemPrompt
methods.description: Builds a system prompt string using sanitized workspace and sandbox strings to ensure no control or separator characters are included.

methods.name: wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock
methods.description: Wraps sanitized text in an untrusted-data block with metadata, including a label and optional character limit, escaping HTML characters.
